summary: Trump Media & Technology Group Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the departure of CEO Devin Nunes effective April 21, 2026, with Kevin J. McGurn appointed as Interim CEO. Nunes ceased as employee, officer, and director, including Chairman. He received a separation agreement providing base salary continuation through September 30, 2026, accelerated vesting of 96,721 time-based RSUs from an August 2025 grant, and forfeiture of other unvested equity, plus accrued benefits under the prior Employment Agreement. This is an abrupt, forced departure of a top executive, constituting a management change event.
